question: open categories 500+ listings avg confidence
sql: SELECT basic_category, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(confidence) AS avg_conf FROM lisbon_places WHERE operating_status = 'open' GROUP BY basic_category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500 ORDER BY n DESC;

question: confidence band breakdown lisbon places
sql: WITH banded AS (SELECT CASE WHEN confidence >= 0.9 THEN 'high' WHEN confidence >= 0.7 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'low' END AS conf_band FROM lisbon_places) SELECT conf_band, COUNT(*) AS n FROM banded GROUP BY conf_band ORDER BY n DESC;

question: most confident named place per category
sql: SELECT basic_category, names."primary" AS place_name, confidence FROM lisbon_places WHERE names."primary" IS NOT NULL QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY basic_category ORDER BY confidence DESC, names."primary") = 1 ORDER BY confidence DESC;

question: places within 1 km belem tower by category
sql: SELECT basic_category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM lisbon_places WHERE ST_DWithin(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true), ST_Transform(ST_Point(-9.2160, 38.6916), 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true), 1000) GROUP BY basic_category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY n DESC;

question: open venues with phone and website by type
sql: WITH contactable AS (SELECT taxonomy."primary" AS tax, operating_status FROM lisbon_places WHERE len(phones) > 0 AND len(websites) > 0) SELECT tax, COUNT(*) AS n FROM contactable WHERE operating_status = 'open' GROUP BY tax HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 15;

question: permanently closed share by category
sql: WITH stats AS (SELECT basic_category, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE operating_status = 'permanently_closed') AS closed, COUNT(*) AS total FROM lisbon_places GROUP BY basic_category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200) SELECT basic_category, closed, total, ROUND(100.0 * closed / total, 1) AS closed_pct FROM stats WHERE closed > 0 ORDER BY closed_pct DESC LIMIT 10;
